description: ISO 20022 Pain.001 Payment Intake — parses a pain.001 XML payment initiation message and converts it to a DPX /settle body. Handles single-credit and multi-credit transfer instructions. Returns a structured settle body ready to pass to settlement.execute, including oracle-validated corridor selection and stablecoin routing. Use this when receiving payment instructions from a TMS (Kyriba, FIS, SAP) or bank that emits ISO 20022 format. Free (parse only); the downstream settlement.execute call carries the x402 fee.

sandbox.description: Pass through to settlement.execute as sandbox mode. Default true.

validateOnly.description: If true, parse and validate without returning a settle body. Default false.

name: settlement.iso20022

payments.description: Parsed payment instructions with amount, currency, creditor, debtor.

settleBody.description: Structured body ready for settlement.execute. Null if validateOnly=true.

validationErrors.description: Schema or business-rule validation errors, if any.
